review_scope: Source-only interpretation and conditional next-step design; the separately labeled posthoc report reads completed AH records.
checks: Exact six protected eligibility records and rank-based displacement differ from functional contribution.
Generation0 matched control provides same-cohort ordinary selection; later diverged candidates cannot be compared by numeric ID alone.
Treatment-shortlist pooled top32 is not generally the full ordinary survivor counterfactual.
Parent IDs, crossover masks and recorded mutations support ancestry/transmission; breeds and slot registry do not mark protected point-mutant lineages.
Full-population depth requires a separately pinned founder loader and new-run identity; no resume or input preparation occurred.
A capture-supported paired reserve result motivates unchanged replication before depth or policy tuning.
